objective: Show library items as summary cards with a remembered Grid / List switch and open each item's full details in a dialog.
deliverable: Reviewable pull request with passing tests; no merge or deployment.
requirements: Create src/app/dashboard/library-browser.tsx and change src/app/dashboard/page.tsx and src/app/globals.css exactly as specified in the acceptance test header. The owner approved a rendered preview of this design.

library-browser.tsx: export type LibraryBrowserItem = { id: string; title: string; line: string; coverObjectPath: string | null; details: ReactNode }. Restore the saved view in a useEffect after hydration (the react-hooks set-state-in-effect lint rule needs an eslint-disable-next-line comment with a reason there). Thumbnails download the private cover with the browser Supabase client (@/lib/supabase/client) and use a plain of the object URL (add an eslint-disable-next-line @next/next/no-img-element comment with a reason), revoking the URL on cleanup; with no cover, show the title's first letter. Render the dialog content only while an item is open.

page.tsx: replace only the
    …
block with where line is ` · · ` exactly as the old list showed it, and details is a fragment containing the existing DraftInspector and DraftReview elements with their existing props and conditions. Keep everything else (data query, search form, pagination, empty states).

globals.css: append style rules without rewriting existing ones: .dashboard-grid{grid-template-columns:1fr}; a toggle row (.view-toggle, pressed button in the accent colour); .library-items (no bullets, gap); .library-grid{grid-template-columns:repeat(auto-fill,minmax(11rem,1fr))}; .library-list{grid-template-columns:1fr} with cards laid out as a 3.5rem thumbnail column and text; .library-card (white card button, border, rounded, hover/focus accent border); .library-thumb (3/4 aspect, object-fit contain); .library-dialog (max width about 52rem, rounded, shadow, padding 0) with .library-dialog::backdrop dimmed; .library-dialog-body padding; header with title and close button.
No data model, API, routing or server changes. Keep the change focused.
acceptance_tests_note: Factory-owned tests run unchanged in the sandbox after the repository checks, together with the existing ai-cover acceptance tests; the builder cannot edit them and must make them pass.
source_manifest_note: Computed by the coding assistant from a separate read-only clone with both the Factory reader and the owner's standalone script; the Factory fetch verifies it independently before use.
